what: The vertical title at the left of a long section and the 438px line groove below it stay stuck to the top of the screen as they follow through the section, and the dark line inside the groove is tied to scroll and fills from the top, from when the section’s top edge touches the screen top until its bottom edge touches the screen bottom (scrub 1 — follows 1 second late). At 1025px and below the line is hidden and the pin is released too

options.scrub: Trailing delay (sec), default 1 — if true, immediate
options.[data-fx-part=head]: Header to stick (child) — sticky within the section
options.[data-fx-part=track]·[data-fx-part=fill]: Line groove and the fill-up line (child, if there is no fill, nothing is applied)
options.--fx-top · --fx-line: Sticky height and line length (style), default 0 · 27.375em

use:
Your section title here

Long body text…

from.where: index.html .p-home__about (original .p-top__aboutTitle data-scroll-sticky data-scroll-target=#about — Locomotive pinned · #js-abouttitle__line scaleY 0 → 1, trigger #about top top → bottom bottom, scrub 1, only above 1025px)

note: The original attaches with Locomotive data-scroll-sticky. This part uses CSS sticky, so it won’t stick if an ancestor has overflow: hidden (overflow: clip is fine). Pages that use Locomotive add data-scroll data-scroll-sticky data-scroll-target to the head and turn this CSS sticky off.
